verdict.rationale: The evidence shows on-request agent work: multi-step tasks in a single request, 'automate tasks like organizing a folder', and subagents spawned within a session. None of it documents user-defined automations that run on a schedule or trigger in the background. The 'works completely in the background' line describes an unspecified system feature, not a user-created automation. The scriptable CLI is only a building block a user could wire to an external scheduler, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
